spans.text: Pokiten mu meinisin non United Nations ra affata me non nour we Charter usun ar nuku pwe mei wor popunapen an aramas meinisin rait, o mi wor namoten an epwe nonnofengen chok an aramas meinisin rait, mwan fengen me fefin, fan iten an epwe wor tipeeu pun epwe wor kinamwe,

spans.text: Pokiten mu meinisin ra fen en me pon pwe repwe ansi ewe mwichen United Nations ne asinengeni unusen fonufan usun angangen are napanapen an aramas rait,

entries.task_id: eu fonu|are|no unusen fonufan
entries.description: eu fonu are no unusen fonufan
entries.subject: eu fonu
entries.object: no unusen fonufan

spans.text: EI PORAUSENAPAN AN ARAMAS RAIT pwe epwe fis pwe eu anen an aramas meinisin repwe annomu non ar ekiek iteiten fansoun meinisin, nupwen ar asukun, are nupwen ar angang ekis meinisin non eu fonu are no unusen fonufan, pwe emon me emon, fonu me fonu, are mu me mu repwe miriti o repwe fori pungun pusin nefiner fengen non ewe United Nations are ar repwe pwan fori pungun ngeni ekkewe fonu ni nom fan tumunuen United Nations.
Esap wor emon epwe tongeni tipis ren och sakkun foffor ika pwe ese sinei pwe mei ngaw ewe foffor a fori, non annukun eu fonu are fen non annukun unusen fonufan, fansoun a fori ewe foffor.

entries.subject: United Nations
entries.object: ar repwe pwan fori pungun ngeni ekkewe fonu ni nom fan tumunuen United Nations

spans.text: EI PORAUSENAPAN AN ARAMAS RAIT pwe epwe fis pwe eu anen an aramas meinisin repwe annomu non ar ekiek iteiten fansoun meinisin, nupwen ar asukun, are nupwen ar angang ekis meinisin non eu fonu are no unusen fonufan, pwe emon me emon, fonu me fonu, are mu me mu repwe miriti o repwe fori pungun pusin nefiner fengen non ewe United Nations are ar repwe pwan fori pungun ngeni ekkewe fonu ni nom fan tumunuen United Nations.

entries.task_id: anuen unuchcher|are|pokiten ir mwan are fefin
entries.description: anuen unuchcher are pokiten ir mwan are fefin
entries.subject: anuen unuchcher
entries.object: pokiten ir mwan are fefin

spans.text: Emon me emon epwe eani ekkei rait o epwe pwan uri mecheresin met mi mak non ei PORAUS, esap wor akinimumu ren och sakkum mettoch, ren anuen unuchcher are pokiten ir mwan are fefin, esap wor nifinifin rer pokiten kapasen fonuer, ar namanam, mefien netiper meinisin, ar newo me pisekir, tori fansoun me nenien are uputiu, are ren chok och sakkun napanaper.

spans.text: Emon me emon epwe eani ekkei rait o epwe pwan uri mecheresin met mi mak non ei PORAUS, esap wor akinimumu ren och sakkum mettoch, ren anuen unuchcher are pokiten ir mwan are fefin, esap wor nifinifin rer pokiten kapasen fonuer, ar namanam, mefien netiper meinisin, ar newo me pisekir, tori fansoun me nenien are uputiu, are ren chok och sakkun napanaper.

entries.description: me mu are fonu me fonu ren och sakkun mefien ewe fonu
entries.subject: me mu
entries.object: fonu me fonu ren och sakkun mefien ewe fonu

spans.text: Esap nifinifin ngeni emon aramas pokiten akinikin nefinen mu me mu are fonu me fonu ren och sakkun mefien ewe fonu, ren aukukun nemenian are tettenin me nein fonu meinisin non fonufan; ese nifinifin ika ewe fonu ni uta non mun, mei nom fan nemenien eu mu, are ika ewe fonu ese tongeni pusin uta non an nemenem.

folded.object: affata me non nour we Charter usun ar nuku pwe mei wor popunapen an aramas meinisin rait

spans.text: Pokiten mu meinisin non United Nations ra affata me non nour we Charter usun ar nuku pwe mei wor popunapen an aramas meinisin rait, o mi wor namoten an epwe nonnofengen chok an aramas meinisin rait, mwan fengen me fefin, fan iten an epwe wor tipeeu pun epwe wor kinamwe,

folded.id: won pisekin|are|pwan an epwe chngeni ekkoch won och pisek
folded.subject: won pisekin
folded.object: pwan an epwe chngeni ekkoch won och pisek

spans.text: Mei wor an emon me emon rait an epwe pusin akkanaemon chok won pisekin are pwan an epwe chngeni ekkoch won och pisek.
Mei wor an emon me emon rait an epwe pusin angang non kefemenin (government) fonuan won inisin are an epwe pusin finata chon aweni awan (representative).

folded.id: wor akinikin|ngenir|ika emon a atai pungun ei poraus ngenir

folded.object: ika emon a atai pungun ei Poraus ngenir

spans.text: Meinisin epwe wor tumunur ren an esap wor akinikin ngenir ika emon a atai pungun ei Poraus ngenir.

folded.object: an esap wor emon epwe ariaffoua pwan emon

spans.text: Pokiten mi auchea an aramas rait me non annuk an esap wor ariaffou are an esap wor emon epwe ariaffoua pwan emon,
